protocol.encode_order: configurations shuffled, one warmup and five default encode/restore trials per condition
protocol.cache: full archive pre-read; warm OS cache; independent phase processes
protocol.matching: all actual requests identical across all configurations and modes for a round
protocol.cross_unit: 4096-byte window centered at a fixed 64 KiB grid boundary; may not cross a 1 MiB parent
protocol.integrity: v2 touched block hashes; v3 authenticated unit indexes and touched unit hashes; full restore verifies parent/file hashes
protocol.cost: complete archive bytes include prefix, JSON, fixed 48-byte unit entries, hashes and encoded payload
protocol.work: unit-aware analytical decoded/encoded bytes; referenced_index_bytes is not cache-miss or physical-IO count
protocol.rss: separate encode/restore/range workers; range includes truth and an unmeasured ledger reader/cache

limits: single host, warm cache, uncontrolled background load; no significance claim
unit indexes cached with a charged budget and at most 128 parents; budget is not a hard RSS limit
v3 deduplicates outer parents only; no cross-parent unit CAS or append-only version store
CSV acceptance can differ because unit entry flags have fixed cost while v2 uses JSON transform labels
